text.text_excerpt: This is actually a nice bar that not a lot of people seem to know about. They do some nice drinks here and the service has always been good. The most unique thing about this place is they have a hidden away "basement" on a lower level down some stairs that if you don't look carefully you might easily miss. The "basement" makes this a fantastic place to hide away and enjoy some privacy from all the hustle and bustle of the French Quarter.

I spent a few hours here by myself on a Saturday night, as my friend was in town for a convention and had to make an appearance from 6:30 - 8:30 pm. I was recommended this place by a waiter where I ate dinner. I was looking for somewhere nice with a minimum "creeper" population and a friendly staff. I had a blast here. The waitress was awesome and I made some friends bellied up to the bar. A great time was had by all and I this was a great recommendation. There is a small bar to sit at, a few pub height tables, as well as a large basement room open to the main room that can sit probably 20 people comfortably. This would be a fun place to come to with a big group and just take over the who...

This was one of my favorite bars in all of NOLA. My best friend and I stopped by while we were walking around, checking out the shops and ended up going back almost every day. The bar is so nice and airy and kept clean. Plus the lady that works the bar during the day is absolute gem! I loved listening to her stories and watching her work. She was so friendly!! She also makes a mean bloody mary! Their bloody mary mix was really better than most i have ever had!
